# 90. Trading Update: September

**Feed**: veckans-trade  
**Published**: 2026-10-02  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Solo trading-update episode in which the host reports roughly +7% for September. His best trades were news-driven large caps (Sinch, Yubico, Hemnet), while illiquid small caps such as Scandinavian Astor and Volati caused his losses. Much of the episode criticises market structure: pre-silent analyst calls (AAK, Munters, Bonesupport), algo front-running and spoofing, and Nasdaq. He calls the Swedish small-cap market very weak, expects profit warnings this reporting season, and argues that hated, forced-sold Swedish real estate at peak bear-market levels deserves research; he has bought Eastnine.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 SINCH — Sinch | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host bought the dip with large size after Pareto's sell rating, citing peer Twilio at a 52-week high with strong guidance.

#### Reasoning

Tactical trade: US peer Twilio is very strong (up 12%, at a 52-week high) while Sinch sold off ~7% on a Nordic broker downgrade. Host expects US flows to lift Sinch, and has seen a short attack on it fail before. This was his best September trade.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Twilio/US peers reverse
- if the downgrade-driven selling continues

> *"Jag gick emot med mycket size."*

---

### 🟢 EAST — Eastnine | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Bought as a contrarian real-estate trade: the sector is hated, funds are forced sellers, and the stock's link to the US 10-year yield is loose.

#### Reasoning

Swedish real estate is at peak bearishness, with constant outflows from property funds. Host argues forced sellers create opportunity and that Polish office exposure does not track the US 10-year yield 1:1. He admits limited real-estate expertise.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the US 10-year yield keeps rising sharply
- if the real-estate sell-off deepens

> *"Jag har köpt Eastnine i ren alibi."*

---

### ⛔ ASTOR — Scandinavian Astor Group | **AVOID** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Host calls it a junk defence roll-up hyped by ETFs; the SEK 16 directed issue broke the stock and he lost money.

#### Reasoning

An acquisitive defence roll-up compared to Embracer and Swedencare. It needed new capital through a directed issue, and the shareholder base is mostly active traders, so dumped blocks find no buyers.

#### Sell Triggers

- if it shows organic profitability without dilution

> *"Det är ett rövbolag. Jag har sagt det väldigt länge."*

---

### ⛔ AAK — AAK | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Stock fell 8-9% with no news, plus three target-price cuts before the 23 Oct report; host says the company 'is going to hell'.

#### Reasoning

Host sees the unexplained drop and the cluster of analyst cuts as signs a weak Q3 has been signalled in pre-silent calls. This is a speculative read on market structure, not fundamental analysis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Q3 report on 23 Oct beats expectations

> *"Det här bolaget går åt helvete."*

---
